faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Gardener post in Kerala High Court?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Gardener post in Kerala High Court is 26th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Gardener position?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed S.S.L.C. or equivalent, along with a Diploma in Gardening or VHSE in Nursery Management and Ornamental Gardening or VHSE - Agriculture (Plant Protection) or VHSE Agriculture.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Gardener post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Gardener post will receive a pay scale of ₹23700-52600.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Gardener post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for the Gardener post in the High Court of Kerala.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to the Gardener post?
faq.answer: For General candidates, the age limit is between 02-01-1986 and 01-01-2008. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST and OBC categories.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Gardener recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee for General/OBC candidates is ₹600. SC/ST/Unemployed Differently Abled candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Gardener recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview or a Written test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the written test be conducted if it is held?
faq.answer: If a written test is conducted, it will be held at Ernakulam.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the Gardener post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply online through the official website of the High Court of Kerala after completing a one-time registration.

faq.question: Q10. Does the High Court of Kerala offer any preference for experienced candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to candidates who have experience in horticulture and/or experience of work in a farm.
